Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : a) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the Electro-Mechanical works shall be 05
years.
b) The minimum specific experience as Supplier in supply of Lift of at least one
(1) contract successfully completed within the last 5 years, with a value of at least Tk. 1.5 Crore With specific job of
Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of one no passenger lift along with steel structure and Glass work under
any Govt./Semi-Govt. /Autonomous body in Bangladesh.
c) The Tenderer must posses:
(i) Up-to-date valid Trade License.
(ii) Up-todate Income Tax clearance Certificate.
(iii) Valid VAT registration Certificate.
(iv) Up-to-date valid ABC Electrical Contractory & Supervisory License from Electrical Licensing Board
d) The minimum amount of liquid assets, net of other contractual commitents, is Tk 125 Lac.
e) Manufacturer's authorization /Dealership /Agencyship Certificate is required for Lifts. All other required qualifications,
special terms & conditions of the tender are shown in the ITT, GCC & Tender data Sheet (TDS) & Tender documents
